description: Captures the deterministic state evolution while the reference DOOM 1.9 plays back the DEMO3 lump from doom/DOOM1.WAD. DEMO3 is the third attract-loop demo. State hashes per 02-012 and framebuffer hashes per 02-011 are captured at tic 0, every 35 tics, and at the demo end. Entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: Launch DOOM.EXE; after DEMO2 finishes, allow DEMO3 to auto-play; capture state + framebuffer at tic 0, every 35 tics, and at demo end.
